problems.desc: Explain why surveying in the library makes the conclusion about the whole school unsafe. Read by hand. A full-credit answer says the sample was taken in a place where quiet-activity students gather, so chess is over-represented and the sample does not represent the whole school; it should name a fix such as surveying a randomly chosen group across the school.

problems.desc: Open response: explain why asking only the students already waiting for the late bus is a biased sample and in which direction the estimate will be wrong, then describe a sampling plan that would not be biased. Read by hand. A full-credit answer says everyone in that queue already uses a late bus, so the sample over-states the demand, and proposes a plan that gives every student in the school a chance of being asked (a random draw from the roll, or every nth name on an alphabetical list).
